subject: geom_smooth when one facet has a single value

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: geom_smooth when one facet has a single value
parts:
Hi all,
I'm having the following problem:

Data <- data.frame(x <- rnorm(20), y = rnorm(20), g =
factor(c(rep("A", 2), rep("B", 17), "C")))
ggplot(Data, aes(x=x, y=y)) + facet_grid(. ~ g) + geom_point() +
geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE)

does not work, because the facet defined by g == C only has one value,
so geom_smooth complains that

"Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, var, value = list(`NA` = NULL)) :
missing values are not allowed in subscripted assignments of data frames"

That makes sense, but I would still like to show the smoother for the
facets that do have more than one value. Is there any way to do that?

Thanks!
-Ista

messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth when one facet has a single value
parts:
Hi Ista -

You can do the work of a stat manually with a little work :

df <- data.frame(
  x = rnorm(20),

y = rnorm(20), 
  g = factor(c(rep("A", 2), rep("B", 17), "C"))
)

s <- sort(c(df$x, pretty(extendrange(df$x), n = 101)))

df2 <- data.frame(
  x = rep(s, 3),
  g = rep(factor(c('A','B','C')), each = length(s))
)
df2 <- merge(df2, df, all.x = TRUE)

df2 <- ddply(df2, .(g), 
  function(df){
    df  <- df[order(df$x),]
    mod <- lm(y ~ x, data = df)
    df$pred <- predict(mod, df[, 'x', drop = FALSE])
    df
  }
)

df2$pred[df2$g == 'C'] <- NA

ggplot() + 
  geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y), data = df) +
  geom_path(aes(x = x, y = pred), data = df2) +
  facet_grid(. ~ g)

Is that what you were looking for?

Cheers
david.

messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth when one facet has a single value
parts:
Thanks David, that is what I want. In fact I think this also works:

set.seed(10)

Data <- data.frame(x = rnorm(20), y = rnorm(20), g = factor(c(rep("A",
2), rep("B", 17), "C")))

tmp <- ddply(Data, .(g), .fun= function(df) length(df$y))
single.values <- Data$g %in% tmp[,1][tmp[,2] == 1]

Data2 <- Data[-(which(single.values == TRUE)),]


ggplot() +
geom_point(aes(x = x, y = y), data = Data) +
geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, aes(x = x, y = y), data = Data2) +
facet_grid(. ~ g)

and it seems a bit simpler. Thanks for pointing me in the right direction!

-Ista

messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth when one facet has a single value
parts:
Thanks Hadley!

In case anyone else is having trouble with this, the following
workaround does work with version 0.8.5:

data <- data.frame(
x = rnorm(20),

y = rnorm(20),
g = factor(c(rep("A", 2), rep("B", 17), "C")))

data2 <- Data[-which(Data$g == "C"),] # remove facet with single values
data2 <- Data[-which(Data$g == "A"),] # need to remove this also
because lm smooth seems to need at least three values

ggplot(data, aes(x, y)) +
geom_point() +
geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, data=data2) + # plot the smoother
using the reduced dataset
facet_grid(. ~ g)

-Ista
